meta.title: Standards & Credentials — Blueprint Code AI
meta.description: Blueprint Code AI's qualifications, standards and working practices across accessibility, security and technical delivery.

opening.heading: Built creatively. Delivered responsibly.
opening.body: Blueprint Code AI combines commercial thinking, considered design and disciplined technical delivery. Our qualifications, standards and working practices help ensure the systems we build are accessible, secure, reliable and ready for real-world use.

credentials.heading: Verifiable qualifications, held by name.
credentials.intro: Each credential below states plainly who holds it — an individual or the company — so there is no ambiguity about what has been formally assessed.
credentials.emptyState: No credentials have completed formal assessment yet. Programmes currently underway are listed under Currently progressing below — we don't display a qualification here until it has been awarded and can be independently verified.

accessibility.heading: Making the complex simple — for everyone.
accessibility.intro: Configurators and commerce tools ask a lot of a visitor. We design and build so that the difficult part stays usable regardless of how someone reads, points, taps or types. Our approach is informed by the WCAG guidelines and applied throughout, not bolted on at the end.

points.title: WCAG-informed design and development
points.detail: Interfaces are built against the Web Content Accessibility Guidelines as a working standard, not a checkbox.

points.title: Keyboard navigation
points.detail: Every interactive control can be reached and operated without a mouse, in a logical order.

points.title: Screen-reader structure
points.detail: Semantic HTML, landmarks and labels so assistive technology can describe the page accurately.

points.title: Colour contrast
points.detail: Text and essential UI meet contrast ratios that stay legible in real lighting, not just in a design file.

points.title: Focus management
points.detail: Visible focus states and deliberate focus moves through steps, dialogs and error summaries.

points.title: Reduced-motion preferences
points.detail: Animation respects the visitor's system setting, so movement never becomes a barrier.

points.title: Accessible forms and error handling
points.detail: Clear labels, described fields and errors announced in text — never colour alone.

points.title: Mobile and touch accessibility
points.detail: Targets sized for fingers, layouts that reflow, and interactions that work on touch as well as pointer.

points.title: Plain-language instructions
points.detail: Guidance written to be understood first time, without jargon standing in the way.

points.title: Manual and automated testing
points.detail: Automated checks catch regressions; manual testing with keyboard and screen readers catches what tools miss.

security.heading: Secure by construction, not by afterthought.
security.intro: The practices below describe how we build. Where a formal certification underpins an area, it is listed under Current credentials once awarded; until then these are our disciplined working standards.

points.title: Secure development practices
points.detail: Input validation, dependency hygiene and least-privilege defaults built into how we write code.

points.title: Application and API security
points.detail: Server-authoritative logic — pricing and rules never trusted to the browser — with protected, rate-aware endpoints.

points.title: Data handling and privacy
points.detail: Only the data a task needs, stored and transmitted with care, and never repurposed for unrelated marketing.

points.title: Authentication and permissions
points.detail: Clear boundaries around who can do what, with sensible session and access controls.

points.title: Ecommerce platform standards
points.detail: Integrations that respect each platform's rules for checkout, data and payments handling.

points.title: Performance and reliability
points.detail: Fast, resilient builds that stay working after launch, under real traffic.

points.title: Testing and release procedures
points.detail: Documented testing and controlled releases so changes ship predictably.

inProgress.heading: Professional development in progress
inProgress.intro: We show development honestly. The programmes below are underway and clearly marked as in progress — nothing here should be read as a completed qualification.
inProgress.emptyState: Details of current professional development will be published here as programmes are confirmed.

clientBenefits.heading: Standards, turned into outcomes.
clientBenefits.intro: Credentials and practices only matter for what they change in the delivered work. In practice, that means:
points: Secure handling of customer and commercial data

evidence.heading: The proof sits inside the work.
evidence.intro: Standards are easiest to trust when you can see them applied. Each project case study links back to this page and records its own:

disclaimer: We use official accreditation logos only where the issuing body permits, and we never describe work as “certified”, “compliant” or “accredited” before the relevant assessment is complete.

close.heading: Want the detail behind a specific standard?
close.body: Ask us how accessibility, security or testing would apply to your build. We'll show you what we do, not just what we claim.
